planned_title: If Voyager Needs 75,000 Years, How Far Is the Nearest Star?
spoken: Voyager 1. moves 17 kilometers every second. At that speed, the trip would take about 75,000 years, Put that beside the light you know. Moonlight reaches you in just over a second. Sunlight takes about eight minutes. So when you look towards Proxima, you are seeing light that left it more than four years ago. and Voyager isn't even heading that way.
